raw_plan.root_cause: The function passes a pointer to a 16-byte stack buffer (rbp-0x20) to helper_copy without any length bound, so an input longer than the destination capacity overflows the stack buffer.
raw_plan.original_behavior: Loads the input pointer from [rbp-0x28], computes the address of the 16-byte buffer at [rbp-0x20], calls helper_copy to copy the input into that buffer, then calls puts on the buffer and returns after checking the stack canary.
raw_plan.required_invariant: At most 15 bytes of input are copied into the 16-byte destination, followed by a NUL terminator; the stack canary at [rbp-8] and the saved frame are never overwritten.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Before calling helper_copy, bound the copy to the destination capacity: compute the input length, reject or truncate inputs that do not fit within 15 bytes plus NUL, and only then invoke helper_copy with a bounded length so the 16-byte buffer is never overrun. Preserve the canary check and normal return path for valid inputs.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: If the input does not fit in the 16-byte destination, do not perform the overflowing copy; return without corrupting the stack (reject the input) while leaving valid short inputs behaving as before.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: For inputs of at most 15 bytes, copy them into the 16-byte buffer with a NUL terminator and print via puts, matching original observable behavior; for longer inputs, refuse the copy so the stack buffer and canary remain intact.
verification_conditions: Inputs of length 0..15 produce the same output as the original function
Inputs of length >=16 do not overwrite [rbp-8] canary or saved rbp/return address
Only direct calls to 0x102cbb0 and 0x108a31c are emitted
Function terminates with ret and preserves SysV calling convention
Stack canary check at 0x102cb93-0x102cba3 still passes for all accepted inputs

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
evaluation_note: deterministic baselines run on the host; PoC evaluation and the unstripped x86-64 target execution run in the Linux guest (Lima) via the poc/guest runner. Provider prompts/responses are never stored.
